rows.grounds: concluding particle referring to the preceding visualization
describes the goddess visualized in the prior verses
object of remembrance; compound of ānanda and bhairava

items.question: What contemplative act must follow visualizing the blissful goddess to enable remembrance of Ānandabhairava?
premises: The preceding visualization depicts a blissful goddess.
Meditation on this blissful form is to be completed first.
Remembrance of Ānandabhairava is enjoined as the subsequent act.
items.inference: Having meditated on the blissful goddess, the practitioner should remember Ānandabhairava.
uncertainties: The precise experiential distinction between dhyātvā and smaret in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Thus, having meditated on her as consisting of bliss, one should remember Ānandabhairava.
